name: Every Word
overview: Scripture reveals the vital importance of every word of God as pure, true, and life-sustaining. Believers are called to treasure God's Word deeply in their hearts to resist sin and live by it daily, recognizing it as the ultimate truth that sanctifies and protects. The warning against altering the prophetic words underscores the sacredness and unchanging authority of Scripture, affirming that God's words are not to be added to or diminished.
